description: Add trade files (broker exports, statements, any layout) to THIS account's own record. Small text files: files=[{name, text}]. Anything large or binary: call with no files to get a 10-minute upload link and send the bytes unchanged (curl -T <file> <link>). Never retype or summarize a large file into this tool. Free.

files.description: Omit to get an upload link. Each item: {name, text} or {name, content_b64}.

name: upload_trading_data
